title: 9:16 vertical composition, ultra-photore
prompt:
9:16 vertical composition, ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, Tang Dynasty-inspired private portrait photography, themed around “The Drunken Imperial Consort,” set in a late-night inner chamber of a Tang palace, with a luxurious and intimate Eastern imperial atmosphere.

A clearly adult East Asian woman in her twenties, with a delicate soft oval face, fair and refined skin, vermilion lips and pearly white teeth, and alluring, languid eyes and brows. Her long jet-black hair is styled into an ornate yet slightly loosened Tang Dynasty high updo, adorned with golden buyao hair ornaments, pearls, and pale pink floral forehead decorations. Several strands of long hair fall naturally along her cheeks and shoulders.

She wears a lightweight Tang-style imperial gown in pale apricot pink, rouge red, and gold. Layers of translucent gauze overlap gracefully, decorated with intricate embroidered patterns and delicate golden ornaments. Wide silk pibo shawls drape loosely over her arms and spill onto the daybed, while the fabric spreads naturally with her posture, creating a luxurious, soft, and flowing texture.

She reclines languidly on an imperial daybed covered with brocade and embroidered cushions, her entire body visible in the frame. One leg extends naturally forward while the other is slightly bent, creating a relaxed and elegant silhouette. One hand rests casually along the edge of the daybed, while the other gently raises a small celadon wine cup. Her head tilts slightly backward and turns toward the camera, her eyes half-lowered, cheeks carrying a subtle post-drinking flush, gaze hazy and languid, lips slightly parted, capturing a softly intoxicated state just after drinking.

The setting is a Tang Dynasty palace woman’s private chamber, featuring a dark carved wooden daybed, brocade cushions, celadon drinking vessels, a bronze wine pot, a low wooden table, gauze curtains, and a peony folding screen. Several candles and palace lanterns are scattered throughout the room, while hazy lattice windows and layers of draped curtains can be seen deep in the background.

Soft-light CCD portrait aesthetic, strong highlight bloom, warm blooming, black diffusion filter, pronounced soft focus with slight defocus. Candlelight produces large hazy halos, softly illuminating her skin with warm tones. Low contrast, low saturation, fine film grain, subtle digital noise, localized dreamy blur, with out-of-focus candlesticks and curtains partially obscuring the foreground.

35–50mm lens, slightly low camera angle, full-body composition, shallow depth of field. The subject is intentionally rendered slightly softer than in modern commercial photography, making the image feel like a candid private portrait accidentally captured inside an ancient imperial palace.

Overall mood: the drunken imperial consort, regal elegance, softly intoxicated languor, graceful movement, restrained sensuality, beauty that comes from presence and bone structure rather than surface appearance, opulent High Tang aesthetics, dreamlike candlelight and soft-focus atmosphere, no text, no watermark.
